title: bondstone preset.yaml
description: A partial profile that profiles extend: packs, bridges, rules, overrides and locked rules shared across repositories.

bondstone.description: Engine versions this preset works with, such as ">=1.0".

extends.description: Presets this one builds on; they are applied before it.

overrides.description: Severity per qualified rule id, applied before the profile's own overrides.

lock.description: Qualified ids of rules that later presets and the profile may raise but not lower or waive. An entry may be `{rule: ID, allow_known: false}` for a rule that must hold from the first day.

allow_known.description: false: `.bondstone/known.json` cannot record violations of this rule.

items.x-error: expected a rule id or `{rule: ID, allow_known: false}`
